limits: Assignment, nominal joint, delivered force and route protection are distinct.
Static distance and requested velocity do not certify achievable interception.
Serialized requested commands may be placeholders for engagement; finalWorldIntent is the delivered target, not achieved movement.
No captured pair cue is an evidence gap, not proof the player lacked information.
Conditional snap combo ownership is not a guarantee either member has already climbed.
Joint retention law remains under physics-owner review; experimental failures are not certified lawful defensive wins.
No native reruns, new roster panel, full games, controller/solver changes or current-develop transfer inference.
